svg.text: ASIC-to-FPGA RTL Adaptation: Gated Clock Conversion & SRAM Black-Box Wrapping
Converting Hundreds of ASIC ICG Leaves Into Clean Global Clocks (`CE`) and Wrapping Foundry SRAMs Into FPGA BRAMs
1. ASIC Clock Gating (`ICG`) -> FPGA `CE` Transformation
Original ASIC RTL (500 Leaf `clk_gate` Cells!):
ICG u_icg_alu (.CLK(sys_clk), .EN(alu_en), .GCLK(gclk_alu));
always @(posedge gclk_alu) reg_a <= d;
On FPGA: Exceeds 24 global BUFG clocks/region immediately!
Turns `ICG` latches into fabric LUT clock trees -> HUGE Hold bugs!
Converted FPGA Equivalent (`-gated_clock_conversion`):
always @(posedge sys_clk) if (alu_en) reg_a <= d;
- Tool traces `ICG` latch + AND back to parent `sys_clk` (BUFG)
- Maps `alu_en` straight onto flip-flop hard `CE` pin
- Zero clock skew & preserves 100% functional equivalence!
2. Foundry SRAM, Analog IP & Multi-Bit Port Wrappers
A. Foundry Compiled SRAM (`TSMC_SPRAM_4Kx64`):
- Strip foundry cell; wrap `mem_wrap` mapping onto `BRAM` / `URAM`
- Map bit-write masks (`BWEB`) -> BRAM `WE[7:0]` byte-enables
- Tie off ASIC DFT / MBIST / EMA pins cleanly via `ifdef FPGA_PROTO`
- Caution: Watch multi-port RF arrays (>2R+2W -> LVT/XOR BRAM!)
B. Analog / PLL / Fuse / Latch Cleanups:
- **ASIC PLL**: Swap behavioral model for FPGA `MMCM` (scaled freq!)
- **Async Latches**: Recode or isolate cleanly (latches hurt FPGA timing)
- **Tri-State Buses**: Convert internal `inout` buses to OR/MUX trees
- **Multi-Cycle / Fast Clocks**: Scale 2 GHz CPU -> 40 MHz (`50x`),
keep UART/Timer baud prescalers runtime-adjustable for fast boot!
